display_name: Manulife Vietnam regular-premium unit-linked life contract terms (Maxx Phúc Lộc Thịnh Vượng; MoF letter 5485/BTC-BH, 13 May 2008): Articles 1-20, Annex 1 and Annex 2

run.method: one agent, one session (resumed after a usage-limit pause on 2026-10-07), no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py quote from line N of the source rendering, and in short runs checked by tools/vnsrc.py check to occur verbatim in it. GLOSSARY.md maps each Vietnamese term to its English identifier with its translation risk.

source.authority: NONE: private contract terms published by the insurer

scope: The whole document: Articles 1-20, Annex 1 and Annex 2, every clause given a disposition in NOTES.md section 2 (encoded, inert with a reason, or reached-and-refused; none out of scope, none deferred). Everything the document leaves to the Policy Schedule or an endorsement, the Company's records and calendar, and the Annex 2 minimums the document never states are inputs with no default. Where the document does not answer, a named REFUSE. The Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15 is an aid only: where it bears on a clause it is a LAW fork, never applied.

forks.F1: Periods 'kể từ' a day: counted from the next day, last day the corresponding date; calendar units.
forks.F2: The next Valuation Date is strictly after the day.
forks.F3: 'Ngày đã được trả phí' is supplied as a paid-to date (the definition says last payment).
forks.F4: Annualised premium = instalment x instalments a year.
forks.F5: Loyalty bonus at the 15th anniversary of the Effective Date.
forks.F6: Article 3.2(i): the Life Insured's own offence only (literal: anyone's).
forks.F7: Article 3.2(i): any offence of the Life Insured, not only intentional criminal ones.
forks.F8: Order on a death: in force, Article 18, 7, 6, 8, 3.2, 3.1.
forks.F9: Article 6 insurable ages = Article 1's 18-65 at issue.
forks.F10: Article 6 two years from the Effective Date to discovery; contract ends on discovery.
forks.F11: Article 6 displaces 3.1 at a death claim.
forks.F12: Article 7 bar: two years from issue or latest reinstatement, during life; no intent required (LAW Art 22(2) not applied).
forks.F13: Article 8 two years from the later of issue and reinstatement (LAW Art 40(1)(a) not applied).
forks.F14: A premium paid on its due date is on time; lapse on due date + 61.
forks.F15: Second-year grace counted from the determination that opened it (literal 'most recent' never ends).
forks.F16: Premium after a holiday: not computed (declined).
forks.F17: A first-year lapse payout is not a surrender; a second-year automatic ending is a lapse for reinstatement.
forks.F18: Weekly valuation = no gap over 7 days.
forks.F19: Notice of fund measures: at least 3 calendar days.
forks.F20: A charge change needs 3 months' notice AND written agreement.
forks.F21: 13.9 c, e: each level at most 115% of the level a year earlier.
forks.F22: 13.9 f: partial withdrawal fee at most the switching fee that year.
forks.F24: 13.9 a: instalments numbered at the frequency paid; same rate by policy year.
forks.F25: 17.2: 20% minimum for each fund named, not every fund.
forks.F26: Article 18: the claim first made must be within the year; a late claim is barred; discovery relief for the Policyholder only (LAW Art 30(2) not applied).
forks.F27: Article 18: two months triggers interest, not a breach (LAW Art 31(1) 15 days not applied).
forks.F28: Article 20(iv): end and valuation on one anniversary; first valuation on or after it.
forks.F29: Annex 1 3.7: 15% of each limit, not 15 points; not for 3.6 or the bands.
forks.F30: Annex 2 A: 8:30-15:00 inclusive same day; after 15:00 next working day; otherwise declined.
forks.F31: Annex 2 F: written request always; evidence and extra premium for an increase.
forks.F32: Article 2 para 3 governs every change, Company notices included.
forks.F33: Article 16: change of beneficiary needs Company approval as written (LAW Art 41(3) not applied).
forks.F34: Article 4 refunds all premiums paid, less medical costs (consistent with LAW Art 35).
forks.F35: 3.3: same-day top-ups count against a withdrawal.
forks.F36: 3.3: one valuation for the bonus proportions and prices.
forks.F37: 9.4 grace charges come off the 3.1 benefit only.
forks.F38: 29 February birthdays fall on 28 February in common years.
forks.F39: 3.2(ii) 'liên quan': a finding of fact, no carve-out.
forks.F40: 11.8: any refund above 0 and up to the refused premium.
forks.F43: Annex 2 D: refusals first; a whole-fund withdrawal is the fund's account value.
forks.F44: Annex 2 E: balance after switch = value - amount - fee; whole fund = value - fee.
forks.F46: In force at death: begun, before age 99, not lapsed without reinstatement; grace counts as in force.
